addInSchedule: Add a training in Events. You’ll plan it here.
lookBack: Look back at a session, or copy its plan.
hereOpens: Who’s here opens when the training starts.
noDraftsWaiting: No drafts. A plan you start and leave half-way waits here.
couldntSaveNotes: Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again. Nothing you typed is lost.
runAgain: Would you run this session again?
noteExample: For example: the rondo grids were too small for this group
pastSub: Look back at a session, or copy its plan into one coming up.
pastKept: Once a training is over, it’s kept here with its plan and your notes.
searchPastPh: Search by name, drill or note
closesWhen: It closes when the training ends and the register is taken. Notes are optional.
forTraining: For {{title}}, {{when}}. Then change anything before you save.
noPastPlans: No past plans yet. Every plan you save is kept here.
plannerOpens: The planner opens with this plan filled in. Nothing is saved until you save it.
noTrainingAddFirst: No training coming up. Add one in Events first.
sameAny: Works with any number. No change.
setFor: {{name}} is set up for {{min}} to {{max}} players. With {{here}}, pick another drill.
unknownPlayers: Trak doesn’t know how many players this drill takes. Check it yourself.
swapTo: {{name}} doesn’t work well with {{here}}. Swap to {{alt}}: {{text}}.
pickAnother: {{name}} doesn’t work well with {{here}}. Pick another drill.
smallerPitch: Make the pitch a little smaller.
todaysPlanFailed: Couldn’t save today’s plan. Check your connection and try again. Your choices are still here.
why_published: only a published event has a register
why_cancelled: this event was cancelled, so it has no register
why_match: a match is recorded in the match log, with its score and minutes
everyoneTicked: Everyone starts ticked, as planned. Trak checks your plan once you’re done.
registerAnyway: Take the register anyway. You can still plan the session.
yourPlanForSquad: Your plan, for all your squad
checksOnceDone: Trak checks it once you’re done with the register.
everyoneWorks: Everyone’s here. Your plan works as it is.
partsNeed_one: {{count}} part needs a change. Pick “Use it” or “Keep” for each.
partsNeed_other: {{count}} parts need a change. Pick “Use it” or “Keep” for each.
partsStuck_one: {{count}} part doesn’t work with {{players}}. Change it yourself.
partsStuck_other: {{count}} parts don’t work with {{players}}. Change them yourself.
planMax: A plan holds at most {{max}} parts.
pickDrillFor: Pick a drill for {{part}}, or remove the part.
minOver: {{diff}} min over. That’s fine, it’s only a guide.
planSaveFailed: Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again. Nothing you changed is lost.
pickThenAdd: Pick a drill, then add it to the plan.
onlyThisPart: Only this part changes. The rest of the plan stays as it is.
addedAtEnd: {{name}} is added at the end. Check the plan, then save it.
alreadyIn: {{name}} is already in this plan, in {{part}}. It’s now set as you left it on its page.
notAddedFull: {{name}} isn’t added: a plan holds at most {{max}} parts. Remove one, then add it from the drill’s page.
copiedFrom: Copied from {{from}}. Check it, change any part, then save it.
saveBackReview: Save and go back to Review
noteForYouDesc: Anything to remember on the day. Only you see it.
noteForYouEx: For example: remind the back four to talk to each other in the box
todayCardNote: Your Today card on Home shows the plan like this. Only you see it.
restOfPlan: The rest of the plan, as it is.
dragHint: Drag a part to move it, or use the arrow keys on its handle. × removes it.
startedFromShape: Started from the parts you used last time.
moveNamed: Move {{name}}. Use the up and down arrow keys.
noPartsYet: No parts in this plan yet. Add one below.
pickPartOrName: Pick a part, or name your own.
addPartDesc: It goes at the end of the session. Drag it to move it.
orNameOwnEx: For example: Pressing game, Goalkeeper work, Fitness test.
noneUsed: You haven’t used any of these drills yet.
noDrillsMatch: No drills match. Try another word.
restOfLibrary: The rest of the Drill Library
setForPlayers: Set for {{players}} players. Press Easier or Harder and Trak shows what it changed and why.
notOnSchedule: This training isn’t in your events.
cancelledCantChange: This training was cancelled, so its plan can’t change.
planYourWay: Plan it your way. Only you see the plan.
needsOnePart: A plan needs at least one part. Edit this one instead, or add another first.
couldntRemove: Couldn’t remove it. Check your connection and try again.
couldntMove: Couldn’t move it. Check your connection and try again.
plannedSquadHere: Planned for your whole squad. On the day, take the register with Who’s here at the top.
overTime: You set this training for {{length}} min. The plan runs {{over}} min over. You can keep it, or change the training's time in Events.
